forecaster_note: Tue: weak, waist–chest, average quality; S-facing breaks cleanest early with light N/NW then breezy NE. Wed: worth a look at dawn, peaky chest-high for exposed breaks, then NE'lies. Thu: a little more NE/ENE swell — chest high with a few head-high sets, mixed up and junky; S-facing breaks / N corners all day. Fri: similar short-period ENE/NE mix, winds better at dawn (offshore) then NE again. — Surfline forecaster, Tue 20 Oct

wind.summary: Light NW offshore ~4 kph at dawn, turning NE onshore ~8 kph by 9am, ~19 kph noon and 24+ kph arvo. Clear, 14°C rising to ~21°C.

shark.summary: SLS drone sighting at North Palm Beach — a shark was sighted by drone at 3:01pm Mon 19 Oct (~15h ago). Palm Beach is at the northern end of the Northern Beaches; none of your 4 tracked spots (Dee Why, Long Reef, Curl Curl, North Steyne) has a detection in the last 24h. Feed is current — newest statewide detection ~30 min ago (Hawks Nest); ~43 real detections statewide in 24h. DPI feed returned no features. Detections are receiver pings or drone sightings, not a guarantee — check the live map before paddling out.
